name: Warlord Krellian
label: Quest
description: Warlord Krellian: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There isn't much time, friend! My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic. I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.
The pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor. Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is not time to waste! Have you the shell?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I must say, this shell has a strange aura. It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...
